# Linear Mixed Models for M-values of DNA Methylation

  
```{r}
# ============================
# 1. Load packages
# ============================
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)      # adds p-values
library(emmeans)       # for post-hoc contrasts
library(ggplot2)
library(broom.mixed)
library(readxl)
```


```{r}
# ============================
# 2. Example data structure (adjust to your data)
# ============================
# Assume your long-format dataframe looks like this:
# columns: subject_id, time_point, group, gene, avg_beta
#
# time_point = "baseline", "t2", "t3"   (or 0,1,2)
# group      = "Randomized", "ActiveControl"
# avg_beta   = average methylation proportion (0–1) across CpGs for that gene

bdnf <- read_excel("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/BDNF_Neuroplastizität_Alter_CpGs_ohne_m11_und_p36_mit_verhalten_vollständig_umstrukturiert.xlsx")

tau <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/TAU_CpGs_mit_verhalten_ohne_p61_p59_p34_p29_umstruk.xlsx"))

psd95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))

 ##first look at BDNF data
head(bdnf)
summary(bdnf)
 ## Check the structure of the dataset
str(bdnf)

```
```{r}
# Compute summary stats per CpG across ALL samples (not per subject)
cpg_summary <- bdnf %>%
  group_by(CpG_position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5% (common in targeted methylation)
  )

# Print to inspect - exclude if invariant or low var
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs
bdnf_filtered <- bdnf %>%
  inner_join(cpg_summary %>% filter(!is_invariant) %>% select(CpG_position), by = "CpG_position")
```
```{r}
cpg_summary <- psd95 %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5% (common in targeted methylation)
  )

# Print to inspect - exclude if invariant or low var
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs
psd95_filtered <- psd95 %>%
  inner_join(cpg_summary %>% filter(!is_invariant) %>% select(CpG_Position), by = "CpG_position")
```
```{r}
bdnf_avg <- bdnf_filtered %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Gruppe_als_zahl, Age_start, Geschlecht) %>%  # Include key covariates
  summarise(
    avg_meth = mean(methylierung, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average across remaining CpGs
    n_CpG = n(),                                  # Count of CpGs used (for QC)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure proportion 0-1 (assuming methylierung is 0-1; if %, divide by 100)
    avg_prop = avg_meth,  # If already 0-1; else avg_meth / 100
    
    # M-value transformation with pseudocount (0.01 is robust for skewed data)
    M_value = log2( (avg_prop + 0.01) / (1 - avg_prop + 0.01) )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_CpG >= 1)  # Ensure at least 1 CpG per average (should be all)

# Inspect the averaged data
summary(bdnf_avg)
head(bdnf_avg)
```


```{r}
# Basic model: time * group + random intercept for subject
model_basic <- lmer(M_value ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + (1 | ID), 
                    data = bdnf_avg)

# Summary and ANOVA
summary(model_basic)
anova(model_basic)  # Type III with Satterthwaite

# Adjusted model: Add covariates like age and sex (common in epigenetics)
model_adjusted <- lmer(M_value ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + Age_start + Geschlecht + (1 | ID), 
                       data = bdnf_avg)

# Summary and ANOVA for adjusted model
summary(model_adjusted)
anova(model_adjusted)

# Compare models (if needed)
anova(model_basic, model_adjusted)  # Use AIC/BIC to choose
```

```{r}
# Interaction effects: Changes over time within groups
emmeans(model_adjusted, pairwise ~ Zeitpunkt | Gruppe)

# Group differences at each time point
emmeans(model_adjusted, pairwise ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt)
```
```{r}
library(report)
report(model_basic)
```

```{r}
# Residual plots
plot(model_adjusted)  # Basic residual vs fitted

# QQ plot for normality
qqnorm(resid(model_adjusted))
qqline(resid(model_adjusted))

# If residuals look bad (still skewed), consider beta GLMM alternative b
```

```{r}

library(glmmTMB)

# Adjust prop for beta: Smithson-Verkuilen transformation
bdnf_avg <- bdnf_avg %>%
  mutate(
    prop_adj = (avg_prop * (n_CpG - 1) + 0.5) / n_CpG  # Handles 0/1 exactly
  )

model_beta <- glmmTMB(prop_adj ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + Age_start + Geschlecht + (1 | ID),
                      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
                      data = bdnf_avg)

summary(model_beta)

# Post-hoc similar to above with emmeans (works with glmmTMB)
```
```{r}
report(model_beta)
```
